quote: Fujian Weiman Power Technology Co., Ltd has been manufacturing generator sets since 1993
The generator sets range from 8 to 4000 kVA and are exported to more than 50 countries and regions.
Weiman generator sets are built in a 15,000 m2 facility in Fuan
Weiman’s decision to use the full range of Perkins electric power engines, from the 400 through to the 4000 Series, in its generator sets
